class.name: DisPlayer
class.brief_description: Plays a DisRecording back into the scene or onto the network, with speed, pause, seek and loop.
class.description: Plays the datagrams of a [DisRecording] at their recorded times. Depending on [member output], each datagram is injected into a [DisNetwork] so that its signals fire as if the packet had just arrived ([constant OUTPUT_LOCAL]; filters are not applied, so a [DisEntityManager] shows the recorded entities), sent on the network ([constant OUTPUT_NETWORK]) or both. Position and duration are in seconds since the first packet. If a [DisEntityManager] is found ([member entity_manager_path], or the first one in the scene), playback speed also scales its dead-reckoning clock ([member DisEntityManager.time_scale], 0 while paused or stopped), and [method seek] rebuilds the picture at once: the manager is cleared and the last Entity State PDU of each entity before the new position is applied, aged by how long before it was sent. The recording is loaded from [member path] when the node is ready, if no [member recording] is set. Nothing runs in the editor. [codeblock] var player := DisPlayer.new() add_child(player) player.load("user://exercise.pcapng") player.speed = 4.0 player.play() [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] Changing the recording or calling [method seek], [method pause] or [method play] sets the [member DisEntityManager.time_scale] of the manager, which stops dead reckoning of live entities while not playing.

method.name: advance
method.description: Moves the playback position forward by [param seconds] of recording time and plays all packets that fall due, without using the wall clock. Called every frame with the frame time multiplied by [member speed] while playing; call it yourself in tests and tools. At the end it loops or, if playing, stops and emits [signal finished].

method.name: get_duration
method.description: Returns the duration of the recording in seconds, [code]0.0[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the playback position in seconds since the first packet.

method.name: load
method.description: Loads the file at [param file_path] into a new [DisRecording] and sets it as [member recording] (which stops playback and rewinds). Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK], or the error of [method DisRecording.load] with a message printed.

method.name: play
method.description: Starts or resumes playback. If the position is at the end, it starts again from the beginning. Prints an error and does nothing if there is no recording.

method.name: seek
method.description: Jumps to [param time] in seconds since the first packet, clamped to the duration. Entities in the [DisEntityManager] are rebuilt for the new position (only with local output), and [signal seeked] is emitted. Playback continues or stays paused as before.

method.name: stop
method.description: Pauses and seeks to the start.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], playback starts when the node is ready and a recording is available.
Path to the [DisEntityManager] whose clock follows the playback speed and which is rebuilt on seek. If empty, the first [DisEntityManager] in the scene is used.

If 0 or greater, the exercise ID (byte 1) of every played datagram is replaced by this value, so that old recordings pass the exercise filter of the live network. [code]-1[/code] leaves datagrams unchanged.
If [code]true[/code], playback seeks back to the start when it reaches the end instead of finishing.
Path to the [DisNetwork] used for output. If empty, the first node in the group [code]dis_network[/code] is used.
Where played datagrams go. See [enum Output].
Recording file that is loaded when the node is ready if [member recording] is not set. [method load] sets it to the loaded file.
The [DisRecording] being played. Setting it stops playback and rewinds to the start.
Playback speed as a multiple of real time. Negative values are set to 0, which makes the position stand still.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when playback reaches the end of the recording and [member loop] is off.

signal.name: packet_played
signal.description: Emitted after each datagram has been played. [param index] is its index in the recording and [param bytes] its bytes (with the exercise ID replaced if [member exercise_id_override] is set).

signal.name: seeked
signal.description: Emitted after [method seek] (also from [method stop] and from looping). [param position] is the new position in seconds since the first packet.

constants.constant: Inject the datagrams into the local [DisNetwork] so its signals fire as if they had arrived. The network does not need to be running.
Send the datagrams on the network with [method DisNetwork.send_bytes], using the network's destination. Only if the network is running.
